career_ladder.note: Technical executive career progression within Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation (TANGEDCO) and Tamil Nadu Transmission Corporation (TANTRANSCO), governed by TNEB Service Regulations. Direct-recruitment Assistant Engineers enter at Class-II (Officer cadre) and advance through Class-I managerial engineering positions up to Chief Engineer and Board Director.

exam_scheme.note: Technical recruitment for Assistant Engineers in TANGEDCO utilizes a standardized Computer-Based Test (CBT) objective examination format covering Engineering Mathematics, Basic Engineering & Sciences, and Core Discipline Engineering. Per state policy reforms, technical engineer recruitments across statutory undertakings are conducted under unified frameworks coordinated with the state recruiting authorities.

stages.source_label: TANGEDCO Recruitment Regulations & TNPSC Combined Technical Services Degree Level Scheme of Examination

papers.paper_name: Part I — Engineering Mathematics (Common to all disciplines: Matrices, Calculus, Transforms, Numerical Methods)
Part II — Basic Engineering & Sciences (Physics, Material Science, Civil & Mech Principles, Electrical Circuits, Computer Programming)
Part III — Technical Core Engineering Discipline (Electrical & Electronics / Mechanical / Civil Engineering Degree Standard)

financial_package.note: Assistant Engineers in TANGEDCO/TANTRANSCO are appointed in Officer Level 1 (₹39,800 - ₹1,26,500 under TNEB Revised Pay Regulations, mapped to Level 16 of the Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Matrix). Employees in thermal power stations and hydel generation circles receive Thermal/Generation Duty Allowance, Shift Allowance, and subsidized electricity benefits.
financial_package.pay_source_label: TNEB Revised Pay Scale Regulations & TNPSC Notification No. 09/2024 (Scale of Pay Rs. 39,800 - 1,26,500 / Level 16: Rs. 36,400 - 1,34,200)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate assumes entry basic pay ₹39,800 with 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025) plus Tamil Nadu Grade-classified HRA (₹2,400 to ₹4,800), City Compensatory Allowance, and Generation/Shift Allowance for plant engineers. Deductions account for Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS/EPF 10% of Basic+DA), NHIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: Medical insurance coverage under TNEB Employees New Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS)
Generation / Thermal Power Station Special Duty Allowance for field engineers
Residential staff quarters inside thermal / hydel project townships or station HRA
Subsidized electricity allowance as per TANGEDCO staff service regulations
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual festival bonus as declared by the Board

competition_benchmarks.note: TANGEDCO Assistant Engineer recruitments attract massive competition from graduate engineers across Tamil Nadu, with candidate application volumes exceeding 1.5 lakh across Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil branches.
